## Klaven Commander (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
Male klaven inquisitor 4  
LE Medium humanoid (augmented humanoid, human)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 15, flat-footed 19 (+1 dodge, +4 armor, +1 deflection, +3 Dex, +4 natural)  
**hp** 44 (4d8+12)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +5, **Will** +9; +2 vs. disease, ingested poison, and becoming nauseated or sickened  
**Defensive Abilities** plagueborn; **Immune** fear  
**Weaknesses** malign influence  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** +1 longsword +8 (1d8+4/19–20), claw +1 (1d6+1) or 2 claws +6 (1d6+3)  
**Ranged** mwk spur rifle +7 (1d6/19–20 plus poison)  
**Inquisitor Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 4th; concentration +6)  

 5/day—battle rage (+2 damage)  
At will—detect alignment  

 **Inquisitor Spells Known** (CL 4th; concentration +5)  

 2nd (2/day)—hold person (DC 14), instrument of agony (DC 14)  
1st (4/day)—command (DC 13), doom (DC 13), protection from good, stunning barrier (DC 13)  
0 (at will)—acid splash, bleed (DC 12), brand (DC 12), daze (DC 12), detect magic, resistance  

 **Domain** War  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** Before entering combat, a klaven commander casts instrument of agony on his longsword and stunning barrier on himself. He also grants a battle rage to his warbeast.  

 **During Combat** A klaven commandery pronounces a resiliency judgment as a swift action when he first confronts the PCs. He then attempts to demoralize their strongest-looking champion with an Intimidate check, relying on his instrument of agony to magnify the effect before engaging them in melee, preferably while flanking with his warbeast to benefit from his Precise Strike feat. If faced with an especially capable spellcaster or ranged attacker, he casts hold person or command to stymie them.  

 **Morale** A klaven commander fights to the death.  

 Base Statistics  

 Without his stunning barrier, a klaven commander’s statistics are:  

 **AC** 19, touch 13, flat-footed 16; **Fort** +6, **Ref** +5, **Will** +8.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 16, **Dex** 16, **Con** 12, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 13  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 20  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Iron Will, Weapon Focus (longsword), Precise Strike, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility, Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Climb +6, Intimidate +14 (+16 with instrument of agony), Knowledge (religion) +7, Linguistics +2, Perception +9, Sense Motive +10, Spellcraft +7, Stealth +9 (+13 in forests and jungles), Survival +7 (+9 to identify or follow tracks); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Intimidate, +4 Stealth in forests and jungles  
**Languages** Common, Jagladine, Ultari  
**SQ** converted host, cunning initiative, energy modulation (1/day), judgment 2/day, monster lore +2, nanite exchange, solo tactics, stern gaze, track +2  
**Other Gear** masterwork light trooper armor, +1 longsword, masterwork spur rifle with 15 spurs, belt of giant strength +2, steel holy symbol (of a black flame on a winged helmet)
